episodes.synopsis: Kanata and Tokio discover a Magus with no memories; Rock Town is in danger when the Enders attack.
episodes.title: My Name Is...

episodes.synopsis: Kanata returns to the ruins where he found Noir to uncover the truth about her past; Range meets Ciel, a Magus, after attempting to lure Noir away from town.
episodes.title: My Master

episodes.synopsis: Kanata becomes Noir's master; Tokio takes Kanata to Desire Nest to turn him into a real man.
episodes.title: Behind the Mask

episodes.synopsis: Kanata battles Enders without Noir to become stronger; he is saved by Claudia and Flamme, who have a request for him.
episodes.title: Wild Daisy

episodes.synopsis: To become a stronger Drifter, Kanata must strengthen his bond with his Magus; Kanata makes his way to the Fes maze with Noir; a group attacking Amasian Type Zero Magus and their Drifters comes to Tokio's attention.
episodes.title: Drifting the Maze

episodes.synopsis: After getting caught in the rain, Kanata and Tokio seek shelter in Baccarat Nest, where they run into Ciel.
episodes.title: Dice Is Cast

episodes.synopsis: Kanata wants to learn more about Noir's past.
episodes.title: My Dear...

episodes.synopsis: Kanata invites Ellie to Satellite Aqua. Thinking it is a date, Ellie finds the whole gang there.
episodes.title: Pure Dream

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Traders Nest, Kanata witnesses a lone Drifter walking in the rain.
episodes.title: Legendary Hero

episodes.synopsis: Kanata investigates who is behind the destruction of the Nests surrounding Rock Town.
episodes.title: Drifters' Pride

episodes.synopsis: Drifters from nearby Nests rush to Rock Town's aid as they prepare to face off against the Silver Storm. Meanwhile, the mysterious group who are after Noir take advantage of the chaos and order Ciel to eliminate Kanata. As the battle drags on, the Drifters start to lose all hope of survival.
episodes.title: Storm of A.I.

episodes.synopsis: It is the final leg in the battle against the Silver Storm. No one is left unscathed and though Kanata refuses to give up, even the upgraded DAISYOGRE is desperately struggling. In this fight to the death, Noir's worries reach a climax and she undergoes a transformation.
episodes.title: Mirage of the Ideal
